{{Quote|Nem'ro's engineering corps works long hours. Many days. Finds way to introduce random variances in hated Fa'athra's automated factories. All is here on datapad.|Rudd|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Rudd''' was a [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Nem'ro's gang|gang]] of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Rudd tasked an individual with delivering a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], containing a method of sabotaging the factories of Nem'ro's rival [[Voontara Fa'athra]], to [[Peblak]], another Ugnaught who worked for Nem'ro. The individual agreed, and delivered the datapad.<ref name="TOR" />
